exceptions.observed: The legacy alignment pages cited approximately 1,077 raw validation artifacts that were not distributed in the public repository.
exceptions.public_disposition: Replace the legacy pages with manifest-derived public summaries, retain the historical or partial validation boundary, and prohibit undistributed artifact markers in public alignment Markdown.
exceptions.resolution_evidence: Static record: README.md defines the public evidence links as repository-local method-status summaries, and the 37 public method pages contain no undistributed raw-artifact path markers.

exceptions.observed: Thirty-three alignment pages contain 42 broken relative links: 33 missing checklist pages plus missing scripts or configurations.
exceptions.public_disposition: Repair or remove every broken link, then re-run the public documentation link check.
exceptions.resolution_evidence: Static record: broken checklist links were removed from the public method pages; surviving repository-relative links target committed inventory, exception, and config README files.

exceptions.observed: The alignment records themselves disclose incomplete category coverage, missing fresh reruns, unavailable source repositories or checkpoints, proxy-only closure, image-only evaluation, or unresolved provenance details.
exceptions.public_disposition: Keep the method in the structural 37-method inventory, expose its limitation in method_status.json, and avoid any statement that all 37 methods share one verification depth.
exceptions.resolution_evidence: docs/alignment/method_status.json records public_evidence=false and method-specific limitations for every affected method.

exceptions.observed: Twenty-three method READMEs contain an incorrect paper URL, an unsupported paper attribution, or no URL despite a verified primary paper source.
exceptions.public_disposition: Correct each method README against the reviewed primary-source mapping in method_status.json.
exceptions.resolution_evidence: Static record: each public method summary records its reviewed paper URL alongside the corresponding method_status.json entry.

exceptions.observed: Canonical configurations require absent .refs assets, local checkpoints, DTD/support-set data, or optional packages not installed by the core package; some paths fall back to non-equivalent behavior or large implicit network downloads. The current per-method READMEs do not disclose those prerequisites consistently.
exceptions.public_disposition: Describe these files as configuration entry points rather than clean-clone runnable examples; make network and fallback behavior explicit, declare method extras, and document or remove undistributed prerequisites.
